notes.title: Multi Level Building and Doors Completed! (V0.9.0)
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We're thrilled to announce that our latest update is now available on Steam!

[h2]Multi-Level Building[/h2]
The community requested feature is here! 
You can now build on different levels of your world, taking your creations to new heights—literally. Use the level tools on the left sidebar to choose the level you want to build on. All tile-based layers will automatically adjust to the selected level, and the ground collision will rise accordingly, making it easier to build complex structures at various heights.

[h2]Doors[/h2]
We've finally completed the door feature! After much work, we found a solution to cut through walls. Hurra! We've also added a UI icon, allowing you to open doors directly from the simple selection tool.

[h2]Other Updates[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scalable UI: You can now adjust the UI size.
[*] Reset Settings: Easily reset all settings to default.
[*] Improved 2D Token Height: Enhanced internal height for 2D tokens.
[*] Duplication Fix: Fixed the issue causing multiple duplications.
[*] Corrected LUT visible state when changing Environments.
[*] Various smaller bugs have been fixed for a smoother experience.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support and feedback.

notes.content:
As we press forward in our quest for the VTT Era, we inevitably come across numerous adversaries and monsters along the way.
Among them is the Lag Troll, a formidable opponent. To combat its effects, we have made some refinements and optimizations to our app.

Our primary objective is to prevent any commands or actions from causing the app to freeze, such as loading an environment. By implementing certain changes, we have enabled asynchronous processes to handle these tasks more efficiently.

Please let us know how these modifications have impacted your experience. Your input is invaluable to us.

[list]
[*]Improved and Optimized Database system.
[*]World Build optimization and improvements.
[*]World Build “Async” loading:
	-Object don't all load at the same time but rather gradually,
        -Added a small tween to the object when loaded so they don't Just Pop Into existence (do you like it?)
[*]Improved and Async Custom Objects load (Have you noticed that when refocusing the app it freezes for a bit? That should be smoothed out now)
[/list]


Join us tomorrow for a livestream at 11:00 AM Pacific Time (PT) where we will provide an overview of our latest update and delve deep into the world of RPGs for newcomers. Veterans, please join us as well and share your world-building tips with us!

notes.title: Salutations Everyone V0.2.0.450b is Here!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/1067051894796722176/1094005513055911956/massplacementShowcase_Environment_4_2.png[/img]

For the last couple of weeks we have been working hard to improve the core of RPGS.
The refactor was focused on improving the data serialization so we can support mode complex data structures for future features. 
As a result we were able to also significantly improve environment loading times by throwing some multithreading wizardry into the mix but we Also we took the opportunity to finally separate the mass placement tool from the object layer and implementing it as a separated system.
Main Change is that the Mass placement tool now Samples from your current selection and as a result it:
1) Works on anything, Characters, Structures, Objects and Groups
2) Supports more objects for more variation 
3) Samples the placement size from the original selected object.

I'm afraid in terms of content we are still working on the next Collection.
But It's an important one so we want to make sure we get it right.

All the best from the RPGS Team!

notes.title: RPG Stories Early Access is available now!
notes.content:
Hello GMs and Adventurers!

In October 2022, RPG Stories World-Builder / VTT got funded on Kickstarter and our team made a promise to deliver the project by October 2023. Although we are still under development we decided to deliver the keys to our backers three months ago and we are now happy to announce that we just released RPG Stories' World-Builder on Steam for Early Access!

Here is everything you need to know about this EA release:

- This is Early Access to the RPG Stories worldbuilding tools only.
- We will be doing a minimum of one update per month, delivering new models, new features, and bug fixes. You, the users, are part of the development now and your feedback is really important!
- The team is now working on the multiplayer VTT, hoping to deliver a lot sooner than promised to the users.
- Everything you build with RPG Stories is and will forever be commercial-free. Feel free to use your creations in any way you like.
- This version features more than 3K models. The final version will contain a lot more, more world-building features and of course the VTT multi-player.
- For as long as the project will be at early access status the price will remain lower than the final's version.
